title: Homemade Summer Sausage
description: A great but easy recipe to use up extra ground venison, elk, moose or beef. It can be multiplied easily and freezes very well. Serve on crackers with cheese and a great mustard sauce.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sugar-based curing mixture (such as Morton® Tender Quick®)

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix together the ground beef and water (if using) until well blended. Season with garlic powder, curing mixture, liquid smoke, mustard seed, and and sugar, and mix thoroughly. It is best to use your hands for this - like meatloaf. Form the mixture into 2 rolls, and wrap with plastic wrap or aluminum foil. Refrigerate for 24 hours.
Preheat the oven to 275 degrees F (135 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment. Remove wrapping from the beef; place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 2 hours. Cool, then wrap in plastic or foil, and refrigerate until cold before slicing.

video.description: Homemade sausage doesn’t get any easier to make than this. In this video, Nicole shows you how to make summer sausage at home using minimal ingredients and only a handful of steps! Salted ground beef is tossed together with flavorful ingredients such as liquid smoke and garlic powder before being rolled into logs, chilled, baked, and chilled again. Serve with cheese and crackers and enjoy!
